summary.text: Mark Tedford is a Republican state representative for Oklahoma House District 69 in Tulsa County, first elected in 2022, and the owner of an insurance agency. He is running for the open 1st Congressional District seat after advancing from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary. According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, his campaign centers on domestic manufacturing, government spending and accountability, and immigration enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Jenks High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri Southern State University (1992).
Earned an MBA from the University of Tulsa (1994) and, according to his survey, a master's in Christian apologetics from Biola University (2013).

Has worked in the insurance business since 1992; his survey describes him as owner and CEO of Tedford Insurance, an independent agency specializing in commercial insurance and employee benefits, and of Camden Logistics.

Before and during his legislative service, held civic roles that his official biography lists, including past service on the boards of the Tulsa Economic Development Council, the Tulsa Chamber of Commerce Small Business Connect and the Jenks Chamber of Commerce, and a "Blue Ribbon Small Business Award."
Elected to Oklahoma House District 69 in 2022, succeeding Sheila Dills; the Republican primary was canceled in both 2022 and 2024, so he won without appearing on the ballot.

Serves as Vice Chair of the Oklahoma House Commerce & Economic Development Oversight Committee (2025-2026); his legislative page also lists seats on the Common Education, Appropriations and Budget (Education Subcommittee) and Energy and Natural Resources Oversight committees and the Legislative Office of Fiscal Transparency.
Finished first in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary for the open 1st District seat with 32.2% of the vote; the August 25 runoff was canceled after Jackson Lahmeyer was listed as withdrawn.
Lives in Tulsa County; according to his official legislative biography, he and his wife have four children.
